name: inspect_apple_ips
description: Inspect one explicit local Apple .ips crash report without executing a target, launching atos, or opening a disassembler. Parses the first-line metadata object and, when bug_type is the string 309, the crash body: process identity, exception and termination facts, threads, usedImages, lossless integer registers, and deterministic classification from documented SIGKILL, EXC_GUARD, pointer-authentication and dyld strings. Other bug_type values, including 288 stackshots, return no crash result. A missing or truncated body fails without partial success. Opened Mach-O and dSYM UUID joins remain unobserved. Portable on supported Node hosts; no Xcode or pwntools required.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

max_file_bytes.description: Maximum stable artifact bytes to read (default 1 MiB)

max_frames.description: Maximum frames across every thread; exceeding the budget fails without partial success

max_images.description: Maximum usedImages rows to examine; exceeding the budget fails without partial success

max_integer_text_bytes.description: Conservative UTF-16 byte allowance for all retained decimal/hex integer text, including derived addresses (default 8 MiB, maximum 64 MiB); checked before conversion and allocation

max_registers.description: Maximum threadState register slots across every thread; exceeding the budget fails without partial success

max_threads.description: Maximum threads to examine; exceeding the budget fails without partial success

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to an Apple .ips crash report
